solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Kind and shy, in part pigeonholed

definitions.note: an actor always given the same sort of part has been pigeonholed in it

parts.note: a kind is a type or sort
to shy is to throw or cast

explanation.surface: A gentle, retiring person feels boxed in by a narrow role.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shy' looks like an adjective beside 'Kind', but it is the verb meaning to throw.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor cast repeatedly in one kind of role is said to be stuck in that part, labelled and boxed.

clue.text: North African sheep stuffed by old group of Arabs

indicators.note: stuffed by means filled with the other piece

parts.note: a teg is a sheep in its second year
the UAR was the United Arab Republic, the old union of Egypt and Syria

explanation.surface: A North African dish of sheep stuffed for a gathering of Arabs.
explanation.walkthrough: TEG is a young sheep, a dialect word crosswords favour.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tuareg are a Berber people of the Sahara, nomads of North Africa.

clue.text: Getting on by overseeing PC subject?

indicators.note: in a down clue the overseeing piece sits on top of the other

parts.note: past means by, as in walking past
IT, information technology, is the subject of personal computers

explanation.surface: An older worker getting along by supervising computing.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting on means growing old, and someone too old to manage is said to be over the hill.

clue.text: Perhaps automatic help given over first sign of crisis of the heart

parts.note: an automatic is a kind of car

indicators.note: over means turned backwards

parts.note: aid is help

indicators.note: the first letter of the word crisis

explanation.surface: Automated assistance offered at the first hint of a heart emergency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given over' reverses AID to DIA.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective relating to the heart, as in an arrest of the heart muscle.

clue.text: Upwardly mobile valuer in City of London having posed outside an office

indicators.note: outside here says the word for posed wraps round everything else

parts.note: posed means sat, for a portrait

indicators.note: in means inside the other piece

parts.note: EC1, read with I for the 1, is a City of London postcode

indicators.note: in a down clue, moving upward means read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: a rater is one who values or assesses

explanation.surface: An ambitious valuer in the City, after modelling, gets a job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upwardly mobile' suggests social climbing, but in a down clue it means reading upwards; 'in' and 'outside' place the pieces. The postcode EC1 has its digit read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: A secretariat is an administrative office or department, as of the United Nations.

clue.text: Ready to work once and for all after partial vacation

indicators.note: vacating part of the phrase empties out some of its middle letters, leaving the start and finish

explanation.surface: Someone declares they are ready for work for good, after a short holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partial vacation' empties EANDFOR from the middle of ONCE AND FOR ALL, keeping ONC and ALL.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor or engineer on standby, able to be summoned at any moment, is available to start work.

clue.text: Tense and serious following initial U-turn about volume one being cut

indicators.note: about means going round the other piece
being cut means removed from the word
a U-turn on the first letter turns the south compass point into north

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A serious, anxious driver making a U-turn, cutting the volume.
explanation.walkthrough: S (south) becomes N (north), giving NERIOUS; removing I and wrapping round V gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Tense describes someone anxious and on edge, jittery.

clue.text: Maybe cheesy guitar playing in band eschewing covers

indicators.note: the clue word that signals this step
without its outer letters, the word band loses its covers
playing suggests the letters being played around with

explanation.surface: A band avoiding cover versions plays cheesy guitar music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covers' suggests cover songs but means the outer letters of 'band'; the scrambled guitar sits in AN.
explanation.definitionFit: A dish topped with browned breadcrumbs or grated cheese is often cheese-topped.

clue.text: In a state of agitation, left head of accounts in it when in debt

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

parts.note: when in debt you are in the red, so 'it' stands for that phrase's last two words

explanation.surface: An agitated accountant, left in it after falling into debt.
explanation.walkthrough: In debt is 'in the red', so the 'it' you are in is THE RED.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse in a sweat of foam is worked up; figuratively, agitated and flustered.

clue.text: Ill-defined muscles needing a stretch

parts.note: abs are abdominal muscles
a tract is a stretch of land

explanation.surface: A gym instruction: your stomach muscles need stretching.
explanation.definitionFit: Something theoretical and not concrete is vague, lacking a sharp outline.

clue.text: Clever old Liberal statesman

definitions.meaning: John ... was a Victorian Liberal politician and campaigner against the Corn Laws

explanation.surface: A smart Victorian politician of the Liberal party.
explanation.definitionFit: Smart means quick-witted; John Bright was a nineteenth-century British Liberal statesman.

clue.text: Building on condition that European cuts curtailed housing

indicators.note: housing means holding the other piece within it
curtailed means having its tail, the final letter, cut off

parts.note: to dice food is to cut it into cubes, so cuts gives dices
if means on condition that

explanation.surface: Planning permission for a building, granted only if European cuts reduce housing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curtailed' takes S off DICES; E plus DICE houses IF.
explanation.definitionFit: An edifice is a large, imposing structure such as a cathedral or palace.

clue.text: Material change of sides in siege once king has fallen

indicators.note: a change of sides swaps left for right, so L becomes R
a king that has fallen drops out of the word, so its letter goes

parts.note: a blockade is a siege that cuts off supplies
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A war story: once the king falls, the besieged change sides.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing K from BLOCKADE leaves BLOCADE; switching L (left) to R (right) gives the fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Brocade is a rich woven fabric with a raised pattern, often of gold or silver thread.

clue.text: Black pants modified

parts.note: pants is British slang for rubbish or bad
tempered means moderated, modified

explanation.surface: A pair of black trousers that has been altered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pants' is British slang for poor quality; 'Black' is the mood, not the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A black mood is a sullen, irritable one, so someone black is cross and grumpy.

clue.text: Wound isn't cleaned in private

definitions.note: an adjective phrase: done in private, secret

indicators.note: wound as the past of wind: the letters are twisted round into a new order

explanation.surface: An untreated injury, kept hidden from view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wound' looks like an injury but is the past tense of wind, the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something secret and surreptitious is kept hidden, carried on out of public view.

clue.text: Motivating words, for example, at the heart of brave men

indicators.note: at the heart of means in the middle of the other piece

parts.note: heroes are brave men

explanation.surface: Inspiring words, say, at the core of courageous people.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrase said to psych oneself up before attempting something daunting.

clue.text: Potter, say, rectified errors about this in Versailles

indicators.note: about means going round the other piece
rectified means put right, so the letters are reordered

parts.note: ce is French for this

explanation.surface: A potter corrects mistakes in a French palace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Potter' is Harry Potter, the boy wizard, not a craftsman.
explanation.definitionFit: Harry Potter is a wizard, an example of a magician.

clue.text: See about case in a way that invites strong feelings

definitions.text: in a way that invites strong feelings

indicators.note: about means going round the other piece

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city and bishop's see in England
the vocative is the grammatical case used to address someone

explanation.surface: A bishop looks into a case that stirs up emotions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb but is a bishop's diocese, here the cathedral city in Cambridgeshire; 'about' wraps it round the grammatical case.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing that conjures vivid memories or emotions does so suggestively, stirring the reader.

clue.text: Spray affected roseola

indicators.note: affected means altered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A spray treatment for someone affected by a rash.
explanation.walkthrough: Roseola is a rosy skin rash.
explanation.definitionFit: A pressurised can that releases a fine mist is a spray.

clue.text: I agree to challenge solvers, ultimately for a very long time

parts.note: the setter addresses solvers as you

indicators.note: ultimately means the last letter of the word for

parts.note: an eon is an age

explanation.surface: A setter accepts a challenge to solvers that will last for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrase accepting a dare or wager: deal, the bet stands.

clue.text: State shortly to provide a welcome

definitions.text: State shortly to provide a welcome

parts.words: State shortly to provide a welcome
parts.note: the US state's two-letter postal abbreviation is HI, a word of greeting

explanation.surface: An official proclamation that greetings will be given.
explanation.walkthrough: The state's abbreviation, HI, is itself a greeting.
explanation.definitionFit: The fiftieth US state, the Pacific island chain, whose postal code is a hello.

clue.text: Bloom's colour about to be hidden by grass

indicators.note: hidden by means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: hay is dried grass

indicators.note: about in the sense of turned round, facing the other way, so the colour word is read backwards

parts.note: dye is colour

explanation.surface: A flower's colour fading among the grass.
explanation.walkthrough: Bloom means one's prime, not a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Bloom as in the prime of life, the period of greatest success and vigour.

clue.text: Runs into bar in passage

indicators.note: into means going inside the other piece

parts.note: bar means except, as in 'all bar one'
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Someone sprints into a pub along a corridor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' and 'passage' both suggest a pub; here bar means except.
explanation.definitionFit: An extract is a short passage taken from a longer text or piece of music.

clue.text: Choice to get on down

definitions.note: down as a noun: soft fine feathers

parts.note: plum as an adjective means choice, best
to get on is to grow older, to age

explanation.surface: A selection of options for getting on or getting off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'down' is the noun for a bird's soft feathers, not a direction.
explanation.definitionFit: Down is the fine soft feathering of a bird, part of its whole coat of feathers.

clue.text: Monster improvement having ditched spin-doctoring?

indicators.note: ditched means thrown out, so those letters are removed

parts.note: progress is improvement
PR, public relations, is what spin doctors do

explanation.surface: A political monster improves once spin is abandoned.
explanation.definitionFit: A female giant of fairy tales who eats people is a kind of monster.

clue.text: Blank cheque made without guidance following split

definitions.meaning: split into two words, a ... is unrestricted licence to act
drawn by hand without ruler or tracing

explanation.surface: A blank cheque handed over without advice after a break-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following split' says the first sense needs the answer split into two words.
explanation.definitionFit: A sketch drawn without rulers or templates is done by hand alone; as two words it means complete licence.

clue.text: In scene, start to move through screen

parts.note: roll can mean start, as when cameras begin filming

explanation.surface: A film director's note: in this scene, begin moving across the screen.
explanation.walkthrough: In filming, 'roll!' is the call to start.
explanation.definitionFit: To scroll is to move displayed text or images up or down a computer display.

clue.text: Limitlessly conceal being personality

indicators.note: without its limits, the first and last letters are dropped

parts.note: to hide is to conceal
an entity is a being

explanation.surface: Endlessly hiding one's true self.
explanation.definitionFit: Your sense of self, the qualities that make you who you are, is your individuality.
